sentences.text:
Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh
 D/L304 C.R.R.4029 of 2023
18.11.2023
Bpg.

Bal Kishan Saria and others Versus Kaushik Basu Mr. Somopriyo Chowdhury Mr. Kaushik De Mr.
Raghav Munshi Ms. Mohini Majumdar.
Petitioners are directed to serve a copy of the revisional application upon the opposite party by speed post with acknowledgement due and file affidavit-of-service on the next date fixed for hearing.

Mr. Chowdhury, learned advocate appearing for the petitioners draws the attention of the Court to the allegations made in the petition of complaint particularly with regard to the factum of 22 cheques being handed over to the complainant with a request not to present the same and subsequently a communication was made that there were no dues.

According to the learned advocate for the petitioners even if the allegations are taken to be correct, the same fails to make out any offence under the provisions of Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code for which process was issued by the jurisdictional court.
Having regard to the contentions so advanced by the petitioners, I am of the view that this revisional application is required to be heard out on merits.

Accordingly, list the revisional application in the monthly list of January, 2024 under the heading "Contested Application".
Pending hearing of the revisional application, further proceedings of Complaint Case No.3037 of 2022 be stayed till 31st January, 2024.
All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
(Tirthankar Ghosh, J.)
